sources.title: EEX Hydrogen Market
sources.classification: weekly market-indication index;Germany delivered-green-hydrogen;not UK spot

answers.question: Does the price refer to a specific delivery region?
answers.answer: HYDRIX reflects an average price for green hydrogen for consumers in Germany. Participant price assessments include delivery costs, but HYDRIX is not a specific delivery price but a reference value.

answers.question: Are transport costs included in the price?
answers.answer: Yes. HYDRIX represents the price a consumer pays for one MWh of hydrogen, including transport costs.

answers.question: What volume does HYDRIX reflect?
answers.answer: HYDRIX does not collect volume data. This accounts for the heterogeneity of the market, and the increasing role young and small enterprises will play. However, participants must base their assessments on all received and submitted offers and completed transactions, taking volumes into account.

answers.question: How does HYDRIX currently work and what results are available?
answers.answer: HYDRIX was launched in May 2023 and has been calculated weekly since then. It is published every Wednesday at 16:00 CEST on the EEX Website.

answers.question: Are prices from future projects considered?
answers.answer: No. HYDRIX only includes prices for the current delivery week. Once new projects begin producing or consuming hydrogen, their prices will be included.
